sources.title: TI TPS54302 data sheet SLVSDG6C, revised March 2026
sources.relevant_guidance: Keep input/output capacitors close, keep SW short and wide, use a separate output sense path and Kelvin feedback ground, and protect feedback from switching noise.
sources.application: Do not casually lengthen or reroute U701 BOOT/FB to obtain an ADC via. R139 trials retain those source tracks and components; actual reference-plane changes are checked separately.

sources.title: TI TPS54302EVM-716 user guide SLVUAP9B, October 2021
sources.relevant_guidance: The EVM keeps input bypass, bootstrap capacitor and feedback divider near the IC.
sources.application: No component or BOOT/FB trace relocation was accepted in this study.

limits: Web documentation was read; no vendor PDF is represented as downloaded/archived here. Native geometry, reference-ground regression and physical qualification remain separate.
